open_items: Zoning district R7-1 and the 2001 rezoning (C 000109 ZMK) are plan facts not backed by a recorded fixture: record a zoning fixture for base lots 32 and 33 (Lane B, after GO; D-090-R009).
The existing building (7 stories, 20 units, 2005) and the 2023 stop-work order are reported by secondary sources only (plan section 11): record the permit and filing sources (task M2-00).

Lot area, frontage and depth of base lots 32 and 33 are unknown: condo base lots have no separate PLUTO record (plan section 4). They need the EPSG:2263 tax-map measurement path or DOF dimensions, never the EPSG:4326 display outlines.

Plan section 11 lists 'lot 33 as a base lot' as unconfirmed, but the recorded DTM condominium response (research section 3.3; test_dtm_condo_soda.py) lists lot 33 as a base lot of condominium 1313: reconcile the plan wording.
Whether lots 32 and 33 touch (so the combination is offered, plan section 3 step 2) is not established by any recorded measurement in the repo.
